cohort: 81 fetuses with estimated fetal weight (EFW) <10th percentile, divided into SGA (n = 30) and FGR (n = 51) groups.
finding: Fetuses with FGR had more abnormal cerebral vessel PIs compared to SGA fetuses, and those with abnormal vertebral artery PIs had lower birth weight, earlier delivery, and more NICU admissions.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in fetuses with abnormal VA PI
